title: Cajun Dirty Rice With Veggie Ground, Celery, Peppers & Carrots

steps.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the vegetables and cook, stirring often, until they begin to soften, 5-6 minutes.
When the vegetables are soft, add veggie ground and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes more.
Add cooked rice and additional broth to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide "dirty rice" between plates or bowls and enjoy!
